info.name: Halden API
info.description: Practice requests for the Halden Outfitters API (guide: docs/API-TESTING.md). Choose the 'Halden (live)' environment, put the admin password in adminPassword (current value only), then run '1. Start here'.

item.name: 1. Start here

item.name: 7. Staff (admin token)

item.name: 8. QA lab (admin token)
item.description: Shared by the whole shop: put the clock back and switch bugs off when you are done.

request.description: Sessions follow the shop clock too: moving it 14 days or more ends every session, yours included. Run 'Get admin token' again after a big jump.
